what: A 9px dot follows in place of the default cursor with .35s expo.out — target (data-fx-part="target") When the center comes within the radius (default 100px, data-range per target), the dot turns into a 60px (84px for large ones) translucent (.1) ring in .175s, and cursor and target pull each other. The target moves toward the cursor by distance×distance/(radius×1.5)×(1−distance/radius×.25) in .5s, and the cursor backs off toward the target by the same amount. Dragging while pressing a panel turns the left and right arrows into a 36px ring gathering in from 10px

options.range: Pull radius in px, default 100 — set per target via data-range (original arrow 30, menu button 50)
options.strength: Drag resistance divisor, default 1.5 (the larger, the less it drags)
options.spring: Share by which pull fades with distance, default .25
options.pull: Time for the target to be pulled away and return (s), default .5
options.drag: If on, a drag ring shows while dragging with the board pressed (original first-page drag to advance)

use: <body data-fx="magnet-ring-cursor" data-fx-magnet-ring-cursor="drag: on"> … <button data-fx-part="target" data-range="50" data-shape="large">Menu</button>
note: If MorphSVGPlugin is loaded, the dot path morphs into the ring path like the original, otherwise it scales up over the same duration (an enlarged circle instead of a ring). The ring shape is a path we drew as circle minus circle. Does nothing on touch devices

from.where: shared.js Cursor (original mouseAttractor) — all arrows, menu buttons and sound buttons, plus the index.js drag ring
